category_meaning.OT_RANGE_NAME: the OT row is a fromid..toid range that gives one name to adjacent CipSoft objects (for example 'weapon of carving' over 23223-23342, 'event item' over 31963-32008, 'simple arrow' over the 22043-22050 ammunition, 'hireling sex change rune' over 29948-29949); the CipSoft objects are the same class the OT attributes describe
category_meaning.SOUL_CORE_MONSTER_LABEL: OT soul core rows with primarytype 'soul cores' whose monster label differs from CipSoft (for example 47779/47783 feversleep/terrorsleep swapped); the object is a soul core in both. Authored presentation names come from OT and are a content data-quality finding for the item-authoring lane, not an identity conflict
category_meaning.STATE_OR_VARIANT_NAME: OT names a sibling state or variant of the same object (lit/unlit lamp, rolled-up carpet, bed part, wrap state, cake variant, soul core colour qualifier, spelling)

alias_name_screening.method: every ALIAS row from Crystal ff7ede5 whose CipSoft 15.30 object has a name, compared after lowercasing, dropping a leading article and punctuation; each difference classified and the attribute evidence of the suspicious rows (ammo, soul cores, hireling scroll, probing device, keys, shields) checked against the CipSoft flags
alias_name_screening.note_on_count: the review's 178 used a stricter substantive-difference filter; this screening covers the superset
alias_name_screening.rule: A12 §4.2: a different OT name alone does not block EXACT; an OT row that describes a different item than its id's CipSoft record (repurposed id) is CONFLICT

d149_gate.semantics_lost: none: every removed definition, including these three, is kept byte-exact in the tombstone archive; no content or apps ref names a D149 key
d149_gate.statement: 1a's 199/201 used the authored (OT) names of current ids; the independent review's 184/201 used CipSoft 15.30 names. Both reproduce. Neither count is a gate input: D149 removes a record because its id is in no admitted CipSoft file.

named_keys.reconciliation: A12 D147 counts the 64 protected semantic keys of the CW2-B1 native batch (NATIVE_ITEM_BATCH in cw2_b1_import.rs). R7-P04 later renamed registry i00002921 to oteryn:item.currency.gold_coin, the 65th named key. Both historical keys of Crystal 3031 alias to oteryn:item.tibia.i3031; the alias verifier allowlists exactly that pair
